Lumbar MRI with red flags – expect approval

notes.title: Sleep evaluation
notes.text: Face-to-face evaluation for suspected obstructive sleep apnea. Patient reports loud snoring, witnessed apneas and excessive daytime sleepiness. Epworth Sleepiness Scale score 14. BMI 34. Plan: attended in-lab polysomnography.

notes.title: Polysomnography report
notes.text: Attended in-lab polysomnography performed on 2026-09-15. Total sleep time 6.1 hours. Apnea-hypopnea index (AHI) of 22 events per hour. Lowest oxygen saturation 84%. Impression: moderate obstructive sleep apnea. Recommend CPAP therapy.

notes.title: Back pain visit
notes.text: Low back pain radiating to the left leg for 2 weeks after lifting a heavy box. Started naproxen 500 mg twice daily and referred to physical therapy. No bowel or bladder changes. No saddle anesthesia. Strength 5/5 bilaterally, positive straight-leg raise on the left.

notes.title: Back pain follow-up
notes.text: Follow-up for lumbar radiculopathy. Radicular pain persists after 3 weeks of naproxen and home exercises. Physical therapy started on 2026-09-02. Neurological exam unchanged. Discussed MRI lumbar spine.

notes.title: Physical therapy re-evaluation
notes.text: Physical therapy re-evaluation. Patient completed 6 weeks of supervised physical therapy between 2026-09-02 and 2026-10-14, in addition to NSAIDs. Radicular symptoms persist with limited progress. Recommend imaging and specialist review.

notes.title: Urgent evaluation
notes.text: Acute low back pain for 5 days. New saddle anesthesia and urinary retention requiring catheterization. Decreased rectal tone on exam. Concern for cauda equina syndrome. Urgent MRI lumbar spine requested.

notes.title: COPD follow-up
notes.text: COPD, GOLD 3, with progressive dyspnea on exertion. Resting room-air SpO2 92%. Six-minute walk test on room air: lowest SpO2 90%. Overnight oximetry: nadir SpO2 91%, no time below 88%. Patient requests home oxygen for breathlessness.

notes.title: Weight management follow-up
notes.text: Weight management follow-up. Patient has completed 12 weeks at the semaglutide 2.4 mg weekly maintenance dose. Weight 108.5 kg from a baseline of 112.0 kg (3.1% loss). Tolerating medication with mild nausea. Requests continuation.
